amendments.timing: after identifying Carter, Perry & Russell 2020 as the closest multidimensional island-isolation comparator, before any extension species outcome

scientific_question: Does species-conditioned archipelago configuration retain held-out incidence information after local climate, island area, continental-mainland distance, direct and area-weighted species-source pressure, surrounding landmass, generic mainland stepping-stone availability, and species-independent archipelago network position are represented?

upstream_frozen.graph_node_universe: the same 842 surveyed/model-linked A-Islands used by the authoritative benchmark; shapefile-only records without frozen species-incidence rows are not added as new neutral stepping-stone nodes in this confirmatory extension

closest_multidimensional_isolation_compa.citation: Carter, Z.T., Perry, G.L.W. & Russell, J.C. (2020). Determining the underlying structure of insular isolation measures. Journal of Biogeography 47: 955-967.
closest_multidimensional_isolation_compa.eog_boundary: these generic island-isolation axes are reference information, not EOG novelty

geometry_gate.source: same frozen A-Islands v1.0 shapefile only

mainland_gate.source: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 Countries, official current release 5.1.1 at contract revision
mainland_gate.australia_feature_rule: select exactly one country feature with ADMIN=Australia and ADM0_A3=AUS, then select its polygon ring with largest absolute spherical area as continental mainland
mainland_gate.distance_rule: minimum spherical point-to-minor-great-circle-segment distance from frozen A-Islands centroid to the selected mainland coastline ring

feature_rules.distance_to_australia_mainland_km: species-independent table frozen from Natural Earth 1:10m v5.1.1 continental-mainland ring before any extension species outcome
feature_rules.multi_source_pressure: mean_s log(1 + sum_{training presence a != focal} exp(-distance(focal,a)/s))
feature_rules.area_weighted_source_pressure: mean_s log(1 + sum_{training presence a != focal} area_km2(a) * exp(-distance(focal,a)/s))
feature_rules.surrounding_landmass_pressure: mean_s log(1 + sum_{j != focal} area_km2(j) * exp(-distance(focal,j)/s))
feature_rules.mainland_stepping_stone_frequency: fraction of frozen geographic-radius graphs where the focal island component contains at least one island whose fixed centroid-to-mainland coastline distance is <= that graph radius
feature_rules.geography_only_eog_connected_frequency: fraction of frozen geographic-radius graphs where focal component contains at least one outer-training presence other than focal

comparison_model.constant_predictor_policy: within each tier and outer-training fold, drop only columns with training standard deviation <= 1e-12; record every dropped column; apply the retained column indices unchanged to held-out rows
comparison_model.rationale: preserve the original A-Islands 5/5 class gate while using the already-audited Tanzania reduced-tier rule so a constant structural column is neutral rather than causing an artificial whole-fold failure

primary_contrast: candidate C minus reference R3 matched held-out log loss
secondary_contrast: candidate C minus reference R3 matched held-out Brier score
